name: Vitigudino (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Vitigudino (a sword and quill in saltire on blue within a yellow frame, surrounded by laurel branches).
history: Municipal flag of Vitigudino; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
